items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: he went into the Tuxedo Band with Papa Celestan and Baby Original and all, the original Tuxedo Band.

ctx.x: Yeah, playing the piano. And then we, uh, let me see, we, uh, then when Paul went, he went into Kid Rene Band, and from Kid Rene Band, and from Kid Rene, he went into the Tuxedo Band with Papa Celestan and Baby Original and all, the original Tuxedo Band. Yeah. And then with all the bands, that was, and getting to late 20s then, we all stretched out into orchestras.
